extraction_notes: Artificial (synthetic) graphite produced by graphitization of petroleum coke. Heading 3801 covers artificial graphite distinct from natural graphite of 2504.
Colloidal or semi-colloidal graphite, often a dispersion in oil or water used as a lubricant coating. Not flagged in_solution as it is a graphite dispersion not a dissolved substance.
Carbonaceous (Soderberg) pastes for electrodes and furnace linings — a binder-plus-carbon preparation, hence chemical_class other.
Residual basket for other preparations based on graphite or other carbon in paste, block, plate or other semi-manufactured form.
Activated carbon — high surface-area adsorbent. Sieve fields left null since no specific particle-size grade is named in the description.
Activated natural mineral product — activated alumina, an adsorbent/desiccant. Treated as activated mineral preparation (other) rather than a separate inorganic compound of Ch.28.
Activated bauxite used as an adsorbent/decolorising clay in petroleum refining.
Residual basket for other activated natural mineral products (e.g. activated clays/earths) not separately named.
Animal black (bone/ivory black) including spent material — calcium-phosphate-plus-carbon decolorising adsorbent used in sugar refining.
Tall oil — a byproduct of kraft (sulphate) wood-pulping, mixture of resin and fatty acids, whether or not refined.
Lignin sulphonates — residual lyes from wood-pulp manufacture (heading 3804), used as dispersants/binders.
Concentrated sulphate lye (kraft black liquor) — residual lye from wood-pulping. Excludes tall oil (3803).
Residual basket for other residual lyes from wood-pulp manufacture, whether or not concentrated.
Wood turpentine oil / spirit of turpentine — terpenic oil from coniferous wood, heading 3805.
Gum turpentine oil distilled from oleoresin (gum) tapped from living pines.
Sulphate turpentine — recovered as a byproduct of kraft (sulphate) pulping.
Terpenic oils produced by distillation/treatment of coniferous woods, other than turpentine oils.
Crude dipentene (racemic limonene) recovered in turpentine processing.
Sulphite turpentine — terpenic byproduct of sulphite wood-pulping.
Residual basket for other terpenic oils / pine-oil products of 3805.90.
Gum rosin (colophony) from pine oleoresin. Heading 3806 covers rosin and resin acids and derivatives.
Other rosin (e.g. wood rosin or tall-oil rosin) under 3806.10.
Salts of rosin / resin acids (resinates), other than salts of rosin adducts.
